texts.date: Monday, the twenty-third of November. Fear Surges as Equities Slide.
texts.story: The S&P 500 fund fell three point six percent in the Friday session. The Nasdaq 100 fund dropped five point seven percent. Extreme fear readings and high volatility marked the session.
texts.tides: The tide has run out for twenty four trading days. Seas remain rough with high volatility. Fear index rising sharply while equities versus bonds and credit point risk defensive. Dollar holds near highs.
texts.equities: S and P five hundred fell three point six percent on Friday. Nasdaq one hundred lost five point seven percent. Broad caution prevails with inflation worries and policy uncertainty weighing on sentiment.
texts.crypto: Bitcoin rose two tenths of a percent over the last twenty four hours to about sixty one thousand dollars yet sits five point five percent lower for the week. Ether slipped one tenth of a percent. Other coins mixed with mild fear prevailing.
texts.horizon: Next scheduled event is the US jobs report on Friday four December.
texts.close: That was your daily market briefing for Monday the twenty-third of November, brought to you by Market Navi.
